title: Bounded parallel Multi-Site health probes
opportunity: Manual health checks probed every upstream sequentially, so multiple slow upstreams could consume the aggregate 10-second budget before all configured upstreams received a result.
implementation: Added a fixed MaxConcurrentUpstreams limit of 8 using SemaphoreSlim.
Executed independent upstream probes with Task.WhenAll while preserving one checkedAt timestamp, bounded failure reasons, caller cancellation, and aggregate budget cancellation semantics.
Added a regression contract requiring bounded admission and guaranteed semaphore release.

verification.healthProbeRegression: 12/14 passed; 2 pre-existing loopback cases were blocked by environment socket_AccessDenied

boundary: Live loopback concurrency execution is blocked by the environment's socket_AccessDenied policy
CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification
